# Recorded temporal holdout fixtures

These four JSON files are the original model/result pairs from the reviewed
`b98742f` implementation snapshot. They preserve negative evidence: the forecast
residual model did not improve the retained holdout, and the queue simulator is
not production qualified. The regression assertions and original bytes are
unchanged. See [the historical archive](../../../docs/implementation/ARCHIVE.md)
for original command captures, image identity and provenance.
